resolution.note: node 26.13.1 and pnpm 12.21.0 pinned in mise.toml, .node-version, package.json, README, bin/krn text, pnpm-lock.yaml; fast PASS on node 26.13.1; CI setup reads .node-version so needs no edit

title: KRN pins node 26.13.1 and pnpm 12.21.0, the newest stable
body:
Operator 2026-11-19: one mise version per tool, the newest stable, pinned the same in every project (workstation skill). KRN pins node 24.22.1 (mise.toml, .node-version, package.json engines) and packageManager pnpm@12.10.1; the newest stable are node 26.13.1 and pnpm 12.21.0. Move every pin (mise.toml, .node-version, engines, packageManager, CI setup in .github/actions/setup-ci and workflows, adopt templates in src/adopt/init.ts if they pin node) to the newest stable.
Outcome: node scripts/toolchain-audit.ts --root <krn parent> prints no outdated line for the krn checkout, and the full Product aggregate Check is green on node 26.13.1.
Proof: npm run fast PASS and the required Check green on the exact HEAD.
